comment: C-first reproduction of pray.c:dopray -> pray_revive. A lawful Valkyrie creates a lawful altar on the starting square, swaps with the adjacent starting dog, uses wizard kill targeting to leave its corpse on the altar (seed makes corpse_chance true), then accepts the pleased-prayer override. C revives the tame dog through pray_revive before water_prayer.
